map.创建训练项目，计时打卡，记录连续坚持天数: Create training items, time and check in, and record your consecutive-day streak
map.单组时长 = 动作时长(s)；总时长 = 组数 × 动作时长 + (组数 − 1: Per-set duration = movement duration (s); total duration = sets × movement duration + (sets − 1) × rest between sets
map.康复训练计时器帮助患者坚持每日康复训练，支持自定义训练项目、组数和休息时间，自动: The Rehab Training Timer helps patients keep up daily rehab training, supports custom training items, sets and rest times, and automatically records check-ins to encourage sustained recovery.
map.多组计时+组间休息提醒: Multi-set timing with between-set rest reminders
map.训练项目计时：在「管理项目」中添加康复动作（图标+名称+组数×单次时长），计时器: Training item timing: add rehab movements in "Manage items" (icon + name + sets × per-set duration); the timer counts down in a train-rest cycle and prompts when all sets are done.
map.组间休息与多组循环：每个动作含「X 组 × Y 秒」，组间自动进入休息时间；可设: Between-set rest and multi-set cycles: each movement has "X sets × Y seconds" and automatically enters rest between sets; the rest duration is configurable to control training density and protect movement quality.
map.打卡与连续天数统计：每次完成训练即打卡，工具统计「连续打卡天数 / 今日打卡 /: Check-in and streak statistics: each completed session counts as a check-in; the tool tracks "consecutive check-in days / today's check-in / cumulative days / total count" and visualizes them to encourage persistence. Data is saved in your local browser and not uploaded to a server.
map.算例：肩颈放松 3 组 × 30 秒、组间休息 10 秒: Example: shoulder/neck relaxation 3 sets × 30 seconds, rest 10 seconds between sets
map.计时器依次运行：训练 30s → 休息 10s → 训练 30s → 休息 10: The timer runs in sequence: train 30s → rest 10s → train 30s → rest 10s → train 30s (3 sets total), for 90s of training and 20s of rest. After check-in the "consecutive check-in days" increases by 1 and the stat cards refresh.
map.怎样新增 / 删除训练项目？: How do I add or delete training items?
map.进入「管理项目」页可增删动作并设定组数与时长；删除后不影响历史打卡记录。项目仅存: Open the "Manage items" page to add or remove movements and set the sets and durations; deleting does not affect historical check-in records. Items are stored only in your local browser's localStorage.
map.全部数据保存在你本机浏览器，纯前端处理、不上传任何服务器；换设备或清缓存会丢失，: All data is saved in your local browser with pure front-end processing and is not uploaded to any server; it is lost when you change devices or clear the cache, so record important content yourself.
map.康复训练计时器是一款健康医疗领域的在线工具。健康指标计算工具，基于权威医学标准，: The Rehab Training Timer is an online health/medical tool. A health-metric calculation tool based on authoritative medical standards, with all data processed locally to protect privacy.
